headline: Names a Hot Springs National Park, Arkansas post office after Chief Petty Officer Adam Brown.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 620 Central Avenue, Suite 1A, in Hot Springs National Park, Arkansas. The building will be called the "Chief Petty Officer Adam Brown United States Post Office." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the designation took effect on that date.
